pcs.pc_description: Understand user requirements and user behavior patterns using various ethnographic research methods.

modules.module_title: Build prototypes to visualize and test AR/VR concepts, — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Understand the purpose of prototypes
Understand different types of prototypes (Low, Medium & High-Fidelity Prototypes)
Brainstorm and outline the core functionalities and features of the AR/VR application. Use sketches or storyboards to map user journeys and identify key interactions
Develop the prototype using chosen tools and technologies. Ensure the prototype reflects the conceptual design and intended user experience.
Incorporate visual assets (3D models, animations) and interaction scripts to simulate the environment and user interactions
Conduct usability testing sessions with actual users to observe interactions with the prototype. Focus on gathering qualitative and quantitative feedback regarding usability, navigation etc.
Use techniques like think-aloud protocols, where users express their thoughts while interacting with the prototype, to capture their impressions and frustrations
Analyze the data collected during user testing. Identify common pain points, feature requests, and areas of confusion to inform the next iteration of the prototype
Based on feedback, make necessary adjustments to the prototype. This may involve refining user flows, improving interactions, enhancing visual design, or fixing usability issues
